entries.referenceText: Our friend lies just in here. Another year of slumber. I wonder if Medivh will ever awaken. It couldn't have been helped, you know. We tried to alter it, but it was all part of a larger scheme.

What do you ask of me? It is said that only a shaman is allowed to know the balance and weight of their totem. Mole Earth Fury! No, I'm not related to that old ox!" "Although you could say my great-grandmother was a cow!

Stay down shaman! Catch your breath! This champion can forge ahead and we will catch up when you are ready. Hear it faster, we are getting swarmed down here! Drekthar! I don't know what you are doing up there, but it is angering the Gorin to no end!
All over now! YOU MAKE GOOD SACRIFICE!

There'll be life all around. Life worth saving. Why you be bothering me like this? Something ain't right. The spirits be crying out. That one had it coming! Bless you, I could feel me soul returning to the lower.
